SELECT  "t0"."code" AS "code",
count(*) AS n
 FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS t0
WHERE ("t0"."__del_ts" IS NULL)
GROUP BY "t0"."code"
HAVING ts_headline('simple', "t0"."description", websearch_to_tsquery('simple', :q), 'StartSel=<mark>, StopSel=</mark>, MaxWords=20, MinWords=5, MaxFragments=3')
